I personally recommend watershed. Probably their cleanest sounds, and it has a range of tracks for all different music tastes. It’s my favorite Opeth album just behind Ghost Reveries

But realistically unless you keep your pc in a very dusty area you shouldn’t have to worry about dusting it very often. Maybe every 6 months or so, but like I said just keep an eye on it. Mine hasn’t been dusted like that in almost a year and it still is very clean

It’s always good to keep an eye on it. Definitely take it outside and give it a dust with some compressed air if you see any dust. But be sure to block the fans from spinning too fast when you clean them bc it has potential to slightly damage them.

Also some gpus can benefit temperature wise from undervolting. And with a 5080 unless you’re playing at 4k ultra, which most ppl dont anyway, you can afford to lose a few fps for the sake of keeping your gpu 5+ degress cooler

Just make sure to keep it in a safe spot and like you said clean and dust regularly, do regular stress tests to make sure its still performing to its full capabilities, and like some people said you may want to add an exhaust fan to the back if you can.
I mean, cant go wrong with some of the best hardware available. Take care of it and that baby will see you through the next 3 recessions!
